Here are a lot of the important locations you can find around the map!  

See the [[Waypoints]] page for the fast-travel locations.  

== '''Regular Areas''' ==
<div><tabber>
|-| Rubble Creek =
; {{Rubble Creek}}  
[[File:Starter_Area.png|300px|center]]  
* NPCs: [[John]], [[Trader]], [[Mechanic]]  
* This is where your journey begins! Speaking with [[John]] starts the tutorial and first quest. [[Trader]] also begins a series of three quests.  
* {{Rubble Creek}} - '''Toughness 1'''
* {{Rubble Creek Deposits}} - '''Toughness 2'''

|-| Fortune River =
; {{Fortune River}}  
[[File:Town.png|300px|center]]  
* NPCs: [[Shard Merchant]], [[Archaeologist]], [[Archaeologist?]], [[Kid]], [[Resident]], [[Steve]], [[Fisherman]], [[Dredge Master]]  
* Small town, big purpose!  
* {{Fortune River}} - '''Toughness 3'''

|-| Fortune River Delta =
; {{Fortune River Delta}}
[[File:Fortune_River_Delta.png|300px|center]]
* NPCs: [[Shady Merchant]], [[Old Prospector]], [[Geologist]], [[Rock Climber]], [[Anne]]
* Area known for its rich sediment, Fortune River flows into the ocean here.
* {{Fortune River Delta}} - '''Toughness 4'''

|-| Crystal Caverns =
; {{Crystal Caverns}}  
[[File:Crystal Caverns.png|300px|center]]

; {{Magma Furnace}}  
<div style="text-align:center;">[[File:magmafurnace.png|300px|frameless]][[File:Magma Furnace requirement.png|300px|frameless|Requires Quest: Fire Protection]]</div>
